findings.claim: The runtime grid borrows 0x8000-byte packed pages; setup overlays an 80x80 ZMAP at +24/+24, and integer sample lookup adds 3072 then splits page/local bits. 004931A4 is an interior load and 00493160 returns height12.
findings.limitations: Binary-static reconstruction; no default-page initialization/lifetime or all-mission claim. Original helper lacks negative page guard; not a general safe coordinate API.

findings.claim: 00493550 has two stack double inputs and numeric x87 ST0 output; double is a readable ABI presentation without hidden result storage. Original RC-down FISTP, float X-row stores and restored-RC final Z interpolation must be preserved.
findings.limitations: Original source return declaration is not recovered; no final float/double store proves declared precision. Historical hardware FISTP qualification retained; no emulator/hardware replay here.

findings.claim: Material uses rounded sample selection and class bits15..13 with outside/invalid fallbacks5/0; normal writes three caller-owned floats using distinct triangle branches, literal world-minus-index comparison and approximate inverse square root.
findings.limitations: Static branches, not broad numerical validation. ftol truncation is a CRT-contract assumption; external implementation unavailable. Bit12, collision behavior and triangle intent unresolved.
